scripts.workspace:status: echo Product Foundation Starter workspace is ready
scripts.dev:demo: pnpm build:demo-dependencies && concurrently -k -n api,web "pnpm --filter @app/api dev:runtime" "pnpm --filter @app/web dev:runtime"
scripts.build:foundation: pnpm --filter @product-foundation/rpc build:package && pnpm --filter @product-foundation/rpc-client build:package && pnpm --filter @product-foundation/rpc-server build:package && pnpm --filter @product-foundation/backend-core build:package && pnpm --filter @product-foundation/backend-postgres build:package
scripts.build:frontend-dependencies: pnpm --filter @product-foundation/rpc build:package && pnpm --filter @product-foundation/rpc-client build:package && pnpm --filter @app/contracts build:package
scripts.build: pnpm build:contracts && pnpm --filter @app/api build:package && pnpm --filter @app/web build:runtime
scripts.check:types: pnpm build:contracts && pnpm --filter @product-foundation/rpc check && pnpm --filter @product-foundation/rpc-client check:package && pnpm --filter @product-foundation/rpc-server check:package && pnpm --filter @product-foundation/backend-core check && pnpm --filter @product-foundation/backend-postgres check:package && pnpm --filter @app/contracts check:package && pnpm --filter @app/frontend-app check:package && pnpm --filter @app/web check:package && pnpm --filter @app/mobile check:package && pnpm --filter @app/api check:package && pnpm --filter @app/mobile check:frontend && pnpm --filter @app/desktop check:frontend
scripts.check:native: pnpm check:native-security && pnpm --filter @app/mobile check && pnpm --filter @app/desktop format:check && pnpm --filter @app/desktop lint && pnpm --filter @app/desktop check
scripts.test:unit: pnpm build:contracts && pnpm --filter @product-foundation/rpc-client test:package && pnpm --filter @product-foundation/rpc-server test:package && pnpm --filter @product-foundation/backend-core test && pnpm --filter @product-foundation/backend-postgres test:unit:package && pnpm --filter @app/frontend-app test && pnpm --filter @app/api test:unit:package
scripts.test:tooling: node --test scripts/read-imports.test.mjs scripts/rename-product.test.mjs scripts/native-runtime-config.test.mjs scripts/check-architecture.test.mjs scripts/frontend-build-config.test.mjs scripts/native-ci-changes.test.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm check:hygiene && pnpm check:docs && pnpm check:static && pnpm check:architecture && pnpm check:types && pnpm test:tooling && pnpm test:unit
scripts.build:frontends: pnpm build:frontend-dependencies && concurrently --success all "pnpm --filter @app/web build:runtime" "pnpm --filter @app/mobile build:runtime" "pnpm --filter @app/desktop build:runtime"
